title: Parameter declaration
description: A policy value as a separate versioned citizen cited by id (ADR-0006 decision 5); policy values never inline into rules. Monetary values are decimal strings to avoid binary float. The values shape is deliberately open: scalars, filing-status maps, and banded tables (range_lookup / bracket_fold corpora) are all parameter values, distinguished by the consuming operation's semantics canon, not by this schema.
